mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with UNRATE > 4.5% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and rise in consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates weakening real estate demand and cost-push pressures that compress profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST decline and CPIAUCSL rise, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals manufacturing contraction that increases recession risk, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days during late-cycle expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO < 100 periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Year-over-year CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.5% signals accelerating inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY instances, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of PAYEMS growth periods, or Rank IC remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: High consumer credit (RSAFS > 470 billion) and strong housing starts (HOUST > 1,150 thousand units) in late-cycle expansion signal robust demand momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of RSAFS > 470000 and HOUST > 1150 instances, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates manufacturing sector weakness and labor market stress that depresses corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise periods, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03.
